# Learn more about configuring your app at https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/tools/cli/configuration

client_id = "0cdb9fdc5d84b78f01508f137fedc028"
name = "Quizsnap"
application_url = "https://example.com"
embedded = true

[build]
automatically_update_urls_on_dev = true
include_config_on_deploy = true

[webhooks]
api_version = "2026-01"

[access_scopes]
# Learn more at https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/tools/cli/configuration#access_scopes
scopes = ""
optional_scopes = [ ]
use_legacy_install_flow = false

[auth]
redirect_urls = [ ]

[product.metafields.app.demo_info]
type = "single_line_text_field"
name = "Demo Source Info"

required = true

content.text:
Fixed. The two issues were:

1. **Empty scopes** — `scopes = ""` meant the app had no API permissions, but the template's `[product.metafields]` section required `write_products`
2. **Leftover template config** — removed the demo metafield/metaobject definitions that came from the Shopify app template scaffold

Updated [shopify.app.toml](shopify.app.toml) now has `scopes = "read_products,write_products"` and no leftover demo config. Run `npm run dev` again — it should prompt you to update scopes on the dev store, then start successfully.
